candidate.historical_run_source_digest: not captured per preliminary run; labels and frozen report hashes distinguish these observations

final_source_identity.observation: Post-run provenance captured after accepted Crater run and selective mutation restored every runtime file; not retroactive per-run source instrumentation.
final_source_identity.algorithm: SHA256 of PHP json_encode(sorted relative-path=>file SHA256 map, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR), SORT_STRING. File SHA256 map below is actual post-run file content; vendor, tests, docs and external executing harness are excluded.
final_source_identity.limits: Individual preliminary/final application runs did not capture analyzer source fingerprints before and after each run. This observed restored working tree and exact report hashes distinguish candidate evidence without claiming a published candidate commit.

tools.dependency_comparison_limit: Published baseline tools and monorepo candidate use their separately locked dependency graphs. Report deltas alone are not a fully controlled dependency-version experiment; failing sanitized regression cases independently establish the named rule corrections. Timings are not causal performance comparisons.

extensions.scope: Presence assumptions are not validation of the deployment host.

harness.tree_digest_algorithm: Recursively hash every regular file except entries named .git; sort relative-path=>SHA256 map using SORT_STRING; SHA256 of PHP json_encode(map, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR). files is map count. Before/after maps compare strictly.
harness.finding_normalization: Retain framework,severity,summary,sorted from->to hop strings; omit evidence IDs/paths/timings; sort rows by compact JSON. SHA256 of UTF8 compact JSON array generated by PowerShell ConvertTo-Json. Text/range changes are retained, not normalized away.
harness.network_measurements: Live repository state, caches, advisory policy and inherited global configuration may change outcomes and timings; these runs are not deterministic gate evidence.

Early candidate reports precede some corrections; final candidates use new labels and do not overwrite historical report bytes.
No new same-major, Illuminate-only or mixed-family staging support is introduced by this evaluation.
A bounded retrospective public-feedback review is linked, not a post-correction runtime certification or fresh feedback solicitation.
follow_up: Complete independent documentation review and the remaining milestone quality/CI/consumer/Wiki/release gates; evaluation completion does not close them.
Retain raw reports until their identities, outcomes and normalized summaries are consumed and reviewed; clean only root-owned temporary evidence when authorized and no longer needed.

Later behavior edits require affected application reruns under new labels and fresh provenance rather than overwriting this evidence. Identity-only preparation is covered by current report, fixture and contract checks; it does not relabel these measured runs.
